title: Elections in India
shortDescription: Election Commission, legislation, electoral system, EVM/VVPAT/NOTA, delimitation and reforms.
genZNote: Largest election on earth, one rulebook: Article 324, two RP Acts and a Commission that doesn't take sides.

sections.heading: Constitutional and Legal Framework
bullets: Part XV (Arts. 324–329); Art. 324 vests superintendence, direction and control of elections in the Election Commission of India (CEC + Election Commissioners); Art. 326: universal adult suffrage (18 years since the 61st Amendment, 1988).
Representation of the People Act, 1950 (electoral rolls, allocation of seats) and 1951 (conduct of elections, qualifications and disqualifications, corrupt practices).

Appointment: the CEC and Other ECs (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023 — selection committee of the PM, Leader of Opposition and a Union Cabinet Minister; term 6 years or until 65.
State Election Commissions conduct panchayat and municipal elections.

sections.heading: Electoral System and Technology
bullets: First-past-the-post (single-member constituencies) for Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha; proportional representation by single transferable vote for President, Vice-President, Rajya Sabha and Legislative Councils.
Lok Sabha: 543 elected seats; Rajya Sabha: 250 (12 nominated); Anglo-Indian nominations ended by the 104th Amendment (2019).
EVMs used nationwide since 2004; VVPAT introduced from 2013; NOTA from 2013 (PUCL v Union of India).

Model Code of Conduct applies from announcement of the schedule; security deposits exist for candidates; sentence of two years or more disqualifies a convicted legislator (RPA s.8(3), Lily Thomas, 2013).

sections.heading: Delimitation and Reforms
bullets: Delimitation Commission redraws constituencies; the seat allocation among states is frozen until the first Census after 2026 (84th Amendment).
Women's reservation: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam (106th Amendment, 2023) — 33% seats in Lok Sabha and Assemblies, to be implemented after delimitation.
National Voters' Day: 25 January; SVEEP promotes voter education.
"One Nation, One Election" proposals are under parliamentary consideration — check the current status.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Elections are conducted by the independent Election Commission under Article 324, using FPTP with universal adult suffrage and a framework of statutes and codes.

highYieldFacts: Voting age lowered to 18 by 61st Amendment.
commonTraps: Do not say ECI conducts panchayat elections.

confusedTerms.distinction: 1950: rolls and seats; 1951: conduct, qualifications and offences.
